These '''Skeletons''' can be found in the sixth room of the [[Lumbridge Catacombs]] which can only be entered after completing [[The Blood Pact]] quest. They are different from normal [[skeletons]] as they have a blue glow in their chest and mouth as opposed to a green one. They were created by [[Dragith Nurn]], a now undead necromancer, during his experiments with stolen corpses.

This is one of the monsters that drop [[Mask part 3]], which can be used with the 4 other parts to create the [[Mask of Dragith Nurn]].

==Update history==
{{UH|
* {{UL|type=update|update=Patch Notes: Part 2 - Combat Style Modernisation|date=2 March 2026}}
** Default base hit chances increased:
*** Magic ('weak'): 65 → 70
*** Melee ('same'): 55 → 60
*** Ranged ('strong'): 45 → 50

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Shooting Star Refresh - This Week In RuneScape|date=16 December 2024}}
** The skeletons in the Lumbridge catacombs have loosened their bony grip on [[oak wood spirit]]s and now drop them as intended.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=November PostJam Patch Week - This Week In RuneScape|date=25 November 2024}}
** Wood and Oak tree spirits have been added to Lumbridge Catacombs skeletons' loot table:
*** Replaced the [[tiny plated bronze salvage]] drop with a [[wood spirit]].
*** Replaced the [[tiny blunt bronze salvage]] drop with an [[oak wood spirit]].
**** Despite oak wood spirits being in the patch notes, oak wood spirits were not dropped as intended. This was fixed a few weeks later.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (5 July 2010)|date=5 July 2010}}
** The new [[skeletons]] and [[goblins]] in the [[Lumbridge Catacombs]] can now also drop champion scrolls.

* {{UL|type=update|update=The Blood Pact and Lumbridge Catacombs|date=15 March 2010}}
** Added to game.
